(section) Concurrent resolution, proposed text
(quote) Only citizens of the United States may qualify to vote in any primary or other election for President or Vice President, for electors for President or Vice President, or for Senator or Representative in Congress.
(other) Resolution asks Congress to propose a U.S. constitutional amendment (citizens-only voting in federal elections, enforcement by states and Congress); recitals on state power over voter qualifications; copy to the congressional delegation.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2026-03-25). Concurrent resolution; no ID or citizenship-proof rule in slots a-d.
(other) note: A request to Congress, not a state law. No strike/new marks (resolution). Only the introduced text is saved.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
